 SSC GD Constable 2026 scorecard, final answer key, response sheet out at ssc.gov.in
 Suviral Shukla | November 3, 2026 | 06:46 PM IST | 1 min read
 Candidates who appeared for the computer-based SSC GD examination 2026, can download their marks and response sheets by using their login details such as registered ID and password.
 SSC GD 2026: Candidates can download the final answer key, question-paper-cum-response sheet through the official portal until November 17. (Representative image: Wikimedia Commons) The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has published the SSC GD Constable 2026 scorecard along with the final answer key and question paper-cum-response sheets on its official website at ssc.gov.in.

 Candidates who appeared for the computer-based SSC GD examination 2026 , can download their marks and response sheets by using their login details such as registered ID and password.
 Notably, the commission will allow candidates to download the SSC GD scorecard and response sheets until November 17. 
 Also read Where are the bank jobs? Finance still hiring, just not where commerce graduates are looking 
 The SSC GD 2026 final answer keys and question paper-cum-response sheets can be accessed using candidates’ roll number and password.
 The SSC GD Constable 2026 exam result was declared on October 12, 2026 for recruitment to Constable (General Duty) posts in Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs) and the Secretariat Security Force (SSF), as well as Rifleman (General Duty) posts in Assam Rifles.
 Candidates will be able to download the SSC GD 2026 final answer key, scorecard, response sheet until November 17 up to 5 pm, as per the official notice.
 The commission has advised candidates to download and save their scorecard, final answer keys and response sheets within the deadline as, these documents will not be available after the specified period, it added.
